role_and_message.evidence: The geometric motivation remains estimation ambiguity of a5x3 transition matrix with closed/open-set components and alternative enclosing simplices.

panel_and_object_coverage.evidence: The entire original three-panel geometry with all matrices, points, boundaries, anchor, labels and shared connecting annotation is retained as one intact source block.

labels_math_and_numbers.evidence: All original T-row indices, y1/y2/y3 coordinates, Sim{T} and primed alternatives, anchor label and clean/noisy decision-boundary key remain exact; the new5x3 heading matches the paper.

connections_and_direction.evidence: Every original point location, polygon edge, dashed decision boundary and annotation arrow is preserved by exact whole-figure restoration, including previously obscured y2 in panel(c).

visual_encodings.evidence: Original red posterior dots, green matrix vertices, blue simplex triangle, black/red/yellow alternative geometry and dashed boundary colors remain unchanged.

examples_and_data.evidence: Independent verification confirms the complete original1005x405 image is restored as an exact2x nearest-neighbor block with matching source/output pixel hashes.

unsupported_additions.evidence: New notes about noisy posteriors, rows ofT, probability coordinates, multiple enclosing simplices and anchor/convexity preventing open-set collapse are supported explicitly by introduction pages1-2. They do not assert a new result.

complete_visible_content.evidence: All original geometry and all indices/axis labels are visible above the separate added legend; no new legend overlays scientific geometry.

remaining_limitations: Exact original source regions are preserved at native or integer nearest scale; enlarged small labels retain original pixel detail. Fidelity audit does not independently validate scientific conclusions.
